vertex_order: R fastest then G then B
packed_bits: {R,G,B}; R high BITS, B low BITS
interpolation: endpoint-aligned exact rational trilinear, denominator (2^BITS-1)^3, final half-up rounding
configuration: single-table full sequential load + checked last + explicit commit, only between drained frames
frame_protocol: SOF starts frame, explicit EOF ends frame and requires EOL
ce: ce && valid && ready; synchronous reset overrides ce
limits: serial compute, 17^3 maximum grid, no board/timing claim
